notes: First-reader proposal only; page not adjudicated. Whole image was viewed once for layout and the two packet halves once each against both witnesses, followed by the saved evidence crops. No OCR, external text, web search or TeX compilation was used.
Line numbering: L00 is the heading; L01–L30 are the thirty main text/display baselines. Interlinear and marginal material is inventoried separately. line_count=31 includes L00.

Original scan dimensions are 1681×2165. All boxes use original full-scan pixels. Crops use PIL LANCZOS enlargement, autocontrast and mild unsharp masking; long edge or width is approximately 2500 pixels.

Content: local description of a positive divisor by a regular equation, the converse for a regularly immersed codimension-one closed subscheme, the associated codimension-one cycle, and the monoid-additivity proposition with the local length argument.

No mathematical proof is supplied or corrected. The absent closure bar in codim({x},X) was checked because H supplied one; the explicit closure bar in the cycle display was separately checked and retained.
Both an equality sign and a plus sign repeat over a source line break. They remain repeated in the diplomatic transcription.
The tiny prime-like trace on the opening D and tiny dot by Z^1 remain doubtful. The clear prime attached to the displayed summation is retained without doubt.
The slanted marginal note reads (sans hyp. noeth.) on two diagonal baselines. Hyp. is on the same rising baseline as (sans, not a separate word before the parenthesis.
The long marginal bracket groups the converse paragraph from est un sous-préschéma through Γ(U,O_X). It is represented by the existing TikZ margin construction, with its word readings corrected.
The severely struck groups remain tentative; in the word before D on L10 the shorter positif is proposed over C’s first candidate préschéma, without claiming that every letter is visible.
The deletion in the proposition stops before the comma following noethérien. The comma remains live. Lower-case l is overwritten by upper-case L.
H editorial heading notes, synopsis and explanatory marginal-note description are not source ink and are not transcribed as body text.
No genuine mathematical diagram occurs; the only nontext graphic is the long marginal grouping bracket. No watermark or printed letterhead was identified.

The existing b09 margin crop was rotated 34 degrees clockwise to display the slanted writing upright; the original-pixel box is unchanged. Expanded white canvas, LANCZOS resized to a 2500-pixel long edge after rotation.
